subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BYour stables keep growing, and so does my respect for you. I raised this {mount} myself, and it has been waiting for a rider who knows how to look after a herd. It's yours now.$B$BYours,$BMei

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BI have watched a great many timelines, and in every one of them you reached the height of your power sooner or later. In this one it was sooner! Take this {mount}; it was always going to be yours.$B$BChromie

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BAzuregos, Kazzak, Doomwalker... I have seen those battles end badly in more timelines than I care to count. Not this time. The {mount} is a small thank-you from the bronze dragonflight.$B$BChromie

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThe Gurubashi bookmakers have been keeping count of your victories, and so have I. A fighter with your record deserves to arrive in style: this {mount} is yours.$B$BShort John Mithril

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThat makes another season of battlegrounds won. The crowds talk of little else, and a champion needs a mount to match. Take the {mount}, and keep winning.$B$BShort John Mithril

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BYour victories on the battlefield have not gone unnoticed in Stormwind. Ride this {mount} with pride, and show the Horde what the Alliance is made of.$B$BKing Varian Wrynn

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BWord of your victories has reached Orgrimmar. The Horde honours those who bleed for it. Take this {mount} and ride at the front of our warbands.$B$BThrall, Warchief of the Horde

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThe Firelord has fallen, and the waters of Azeroth are calmer for it. The Core Hounds that served him will serve you now; this one has been tamed. Take good care of it, and keep it away from water.$B$BDuke Hydraxis

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BYou faced the Observer and Azeroth is still here! I found this {mount} in one of the halls of Ulduar, and the titans' machines took to you better than they ever did to me. It's yours.$B$BBrann Bronzebeard

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThe Oracles have seen your deeds in the waters of the basin, and the Great Ones smile. Please take this {mount} as our thanks.$B$BHigh-Oracle Soo-say

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThe Kalu'ak do not forget a friend. You have stood with our people from the Borean Tundra to the Howling Fjord. This {mount} carried our hunters across the ice; now it will carry you.$B$BElder Ko'nani

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThe Kalu'ak, the Oracles and even the Frenzyheart speak your name with respect. Few walk between so many peoples. This {mount} is a gift from all of us.$B$BElder Ko'nani

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThe Netherwing are free because of you, and Neltharaku asked that you be thanked properly. This {mount} chose you as its rider.$B$BMordenai

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThe Sunwell is restored and the Isle is ours again. The Shattered Sun Offensive owes you a debt. Please accept this {mount}.$B$BLord Torvos

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BOgri'la is safe and the crystals sing your name. The ogres of the Blade's Edge are not given to gifts, but this {mount} is one.$B$BChu'a'lor

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThe Consortium values its most profitable friends. Consider this {mount} a dividend on our partnership.$B$BNexus-Prince Haramad

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BYou have walked every road of Netherstorm and finished every job we had there. The Consortium does not usually give anything away for free, but this {mount} is yours.$B$BNexus-Prince Haramad

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThe Thorium Brotherhood and the Hydraxian Waterlords agree on very little, but they agree on you. This {mount} was forged for a friend of both.$B$BLokhtos Darkbargainer

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThe waters of Zangarmarsh are flowing freely again, and the Cenarion Expedition thanks you. This {mount} was found in the depths of Coilfang; it seems to like you.$B$BYsiel Windsinger

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BBooty Bay, Gadgetzan, Ratchet and Everlook all count you as a friend, which makes you very good for business. Here's a {mount} to get you between them faster.$B$BBaron Revilgaz

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThe Ashtongue Deathsworn will not forget what you have done in Shadowmoon Valley. Take this {mount}, friend of the Broken.$B$BAkama

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThe Sons of Hodir sing of your deeds in the Storm Peaks. Hodir himself wished you to have this {mount}.$B$BKing Jokkum

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BYour work in Tanaris and Silithus has kept the timeways steady. The Keepers of Time wish you to have this {mount}.$B$BSteward of Time

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThe infinite dragonflight tried to undo Thrall's escape, and you would not let them, even on the hardest road. Accept this {mount} from the Keepers of Time.$B$BSteward of Time

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BFew have seen as much of Northrend as you have. Dalaran's scholars could fill a library with your travels. This {mount} will carry you to the next one.$B$BKrasus

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BYou have mapped Northrend from end to end and held Wintergrasp. Dalaran is grateful; take this {mount} for the roads ahead.$B$BKrasus

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThe marshes have quieted since you came through. Even the Theramore guards nod at me now, which is your doing. Take this {mount}; it doesn't mind the mud.$B$BTabetha

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThe Isle of Quel'Danas will remember you. This {mount} is a gift from those who fought beside you there.$B$BLady Liadrin

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThe centaur of Desolace fear you and the earth remembers your footsteps. Uthek has seen it in the stones. Take this {mount}.$B$BUthek the Wise

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BYou've done more for the prisoners of Blackrock Depths than any king I've known. Take this {mount} as thanks from the Mighthammer clan.$B$BKharan Mighthammer

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThermaplugg is beaten and Gnomeregan has a future again! I've been tinkering with this {mount} for weeks, and I can't think of a better test pilot.$B$BTinkmaster Overspark

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThe Night Watch is short on hands, and whatever banner you fly, you did the work of a dozen. Duskwood is safer for it. Take this {mount}; it doesn't scare easily.$B$BCommander Althea Ebonlocke

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThe titans' works in Sholazar Basin and the Storm Peaks hold few secrets from you now. The green dragonflight sends you this {mount} with its thanks.$B$BLord Itharius

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BBest catch I've seen in years! Every winner of the Extravaganza gets a prize, and you get a special one: this {mount}. Don't get it wet.$B$BRiggle Bassbait

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BI have spent my life between peoples who would rather not speak to each other. You have earned the trust of more of them than I ever did. Take this {mount}.$B$BKhadgar

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BYou have seen all of Outland, done its work and won the trust of its peoples. I could not have asked for more. This {mount} is my thanks.$B$BKhadgar

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BBrewfest, Midsummer and Hallow's End: you have danced, drunk and lit the fires with the best of them. This {mount} is for the life of every party.$B$BAlexstrasza the Life-Binder

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BNorthrend has awoken, and you were there for all of it. The Aspects ask you to accept this {mount}.$B$BAlexstrasza the Life-Binder

subject: {title}
body: $N,$B$BThe Lich King is dead and the Scourge is broken. The Knights of the Ebon Blade will remember who stood at the Frozen Throne. Take this {mount}.$B$BHighlord Darion Mograine
